question: What happens on a page fault?

beats.speaker: interviewer
beats.line: What happens on a page fault?
beats.on_screen: What happens on a page fault?

beats.speaker: student
beats.line: When the valid bit is clear the MMU raises a page fault trap to the operating system.
beats.on_screen: When the valid bit is clear
beats.source_quote:
it raises a page
fault trap to the operating system

beats.speaker: student
beats.line: The OS locates the page on the backing store and issues the disk read.
